submission.justification: Absorber-F2 with 6 mm plates gives the best recorded 100 GeV energy resolution among all allowed candidates and tested plate thicknesses: 3.0%. All three candidate absorbers are allowed and compatible with hands-on shutdown maintenance, and the selected 6 mm thickness is within the required 2–10 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: The scan found the minimum recorded resolution to be 3.0% for Absorber-F2 at 6 mm; this was the best in both the coarse and integer scans.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 is one of the three allowed candidate materials; selected_material_listed_in_candidate_specs = 1.

requirements.requirement: The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 satisfies the hands-on maintenance condition; hands_on_Absorber_F2_ok = 1 and selected_hands_on_maintenance_allowed = 1.
The selected thickness is 6 mm, within the allowed 2–10 mm range; selected_thickness_within_2_10mm = 1.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Absorber-F2 with 6 mm plate thickness.
